catalog_change_target.name: catalog_change_target
catalog_change_target.value: ("inventory_catalog_changes"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("inventory_catalog_changes"."location_id" IS NOT NULL)

operation_type_valid.name: operation_type_valid
operation_type_valid.value: ("inventory_operations"."type" = 'TRANSFER' AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" <> "inventory_operations"."source_id") OR ("inventory_operations"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" IS NULL)
